name: cj-ways/arcana
description: A CLI-managed collection of 18 engineering and design workflow skills, including audits, reviews, fixes, planning, test generation, release checks, security checks, and a design-phase prompt skill for v0.dev. The sample skill read covers v0 design prompting. The CLI supports init with a dry-run preview and plugin install.
install: npx @cj-ways/arcana init (with --dry-run preview documented) and plugin route (/plugin install arcana@cj-ways-skills). Only the CLI/plugin install is drafted.
